FULLY REFURBISHED FIVE BEDROOM HOUSE SHARED WITH EN SUITES

My Property Box are pleased to bring to the market this newly renovated, furnished double room in a five bedroom shared house of professionals. This large double bedroom is located on the ground floor, comes fully furnished, and includes all bills. Also includes Council Tax, Virgin Media Fibre Broadband and TV Package. The property itself is in the town centre and has great transport links. Property comprises of: Furnished Double Bedroom, Shared Lounge, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen, Shared Bathroom.
